name: extract-quiver-and-get-rassart
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd()
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/quiver.pdf','-'],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/quiver.txt'],input=r.stdout,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
s=r.stdout.decode();print(s[:11000]);pos=s.find('Corollary 9.4');print(s[pos-10000:pos+5000])
plan=dict(url='https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0308101',routes=['318479'],destination='sources/rassart.pdf',source_identity='Etienne Rassart A polynomiality property for Littlewood Richardson coefficients math0308101',purpose='Authenticate exact finite chamber polynomiality theorem and proof for affine rays')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'plans/get-rassart.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'source_get_guard.py'),str(p/'plans/get-rassart.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr);sys.exit(r.returncode)
